# Contradiction notice: the brief is Estimated, not Verified

Raised to the owner in the brief header and repeated here for the record.

The OpportunityContract named the primary artifact "A source-linked Verified Weekly Salon Brief."
This build ships a brief labelled **Estimated Weekly Salon Brief**.

Why: verification requires every expense row to carry a matched receipt. Measured receipt match
coverage for the pilot week was 0.71 (see receipt-match-coverage.json). A brief calling itself
"Verified" at 0.71 coverage would be asserting a property it cannot show, which is the precise
failure this journey exists to prevent. The word was changed rather than the threshold.

What remains true from the contract: the brief is source-linked, every figure traces to an
uploaded row, and the verification queue names every item standing between "estimated" and
"verified".

What is not authorized by this notice: nothing. This records a contradiction and its reason. It
does not constitute acceptance of the contradiction by the contract's owner.
